name: Whitehorse Adventure Playground
description: Fully inclusive adventure playground on Whitehorse Road for 8 to 25 year olds with ball courts and an indoor community space. It runs sessions from 3pm to 6pm, Tuesday to Thursday in term time, as Tower Hamlets Council lists it.
